subject.title: System prompt: add guidance for spawning background sub-agents

question: Should this PR be rebased and consolidated into the existing sub-agent prompt/tool-description surfaces, or closed because current main already covers the central guidance?
rationale: Current main already has overlapping guidance and supports configured nested spawning, while this PR adds a duplicate rubric and contradictory nesting policy; choosing the permanent prompt policy requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Rebase And Consolidate Guidance
options.body: Keep only useful non-duplicative examples and merge them into the existing availability-aware and depth-aware surfaces.

options.title: Close As Covered
options.body: Treat the current-main guidance and merged tool-description work as sufficient and close this stale branch without adding another prompt-policy source.

options.title: Change Nested Policy Coherently
options.body: If nested spawning should be forbidden, update runtime config, prompts, docs, and tests together so every surface agrees.

recommendation.title: Rebase And Consolidate Guidance
recommendation.body: Keep only useful non-duplicative examples and merge them into the existing availability-aware and depth-aware surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: They opened this maintainer prompt-policy PR and already commented on the related rejected tool-policy direction.
